correctness.rationale: The circulant eigenspaces are Fourier characters. The actual RESULT.md expresses each eigenvalue as an infinite positive Gaussian theta periodization P minus the omitted symmetric Gaussian tail E. Poisson summation gives P>=sqrt(pi n/c) exp(-pi^2 n/(4c)); E=O(exp(-cn/4)) for all frequencies, proving positivity when c>pi. For c<pi choose the largest even index <=floor(n/2): exact even tail has positive scaled limit tanh(c/2), while the paired odd tail has positive first scaled derivative pi*delta exp(-c/2)(1-exp(-c))/(1+exp(-c))^2, delta=1 or 3. Exponential-rate comparison suppresses P and yields negative eigenvalue and sharp asymptotics. Positivity of a Schur multiplier is equivalent to positive semidefiniteness of its symbol (apply to the all-ones rank-one matrix); proof addresses all n sufficiently large separately for both parities. Independent mpmath Fourier/periodization calculations checked signed modes and both leading constants, not the all-n theorem.
residual_risks: Finite independent calculations do not replace the analytic and infinite-quantifier parts of the proof.
